annotations.title: OpenGraph, Twitter Cards & JSON-LD Microdata Extractor

description: Extracts OpenGraph tags, Twitter Card metadata, canonical URLs, and Schema.org JSON-LD microdata scripts from HTML. Use when indexing social share cards, author identity, breadcrumbs, and rich snippet schemas for AI search agents; for scanning page hyperlinks and outbound references, use extract_page_hyperlinks instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('metadata_targets' defaults to 'all_protocols'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

html_content.description: Source HTML string containing head tags, OpenGraph meta properties, or JSON-LD scripts.

include_favicons.description: Whether to extract favicon links and Apple Touch icon references.

metadata_targets.description: Target metadata protocol filter: all protocols, OpenGraph and Twitter, or Schema.org JSON-LD.

name: extract_structured_metadata

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for extract_structured_metadata.

canonical_url.description: Canonical canonical link target or empty string if unspecified.

json_ld_schemas.description: Parsed Schema.org JSON-LD structured data objects.

open_graph.description: Structured OpenGraph properties including og:title, og:image, and og:description.

twitter_card.description: Twitter Card metadata including twitter:card, twitter:creator, and twitter:image.
